snippet.title: 『Crescent Tower』Steam version set to be released by AMATA Games in 2025!
snippet.description:
"Crescent Tower" is an authentic 8-bit style dungeon crawl RPG packed with retro flavor, dedicated to all RPG fans. Indie game developer "Karee Korokke" began distribution of the early access version in November 2024, generating buzz as a retro-style 2D dungeon RPG. Now, to allow even more people to enjoy "Crescent Tower," AMATA Games has decided to release the Steam version.

Factsheet
Title: Crescent Tower (Japanese Title: クレセント・タワー)
Genre: Authentic 8-bit style dungeon crawl RPG
Supported Hardware: Steam
Distributing Stores (Download only): Steam
Number of Players: 1
Online Play: No online play is available.
Languages supported: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, German, French
Price: Undecided
Release Date: 2025
Rating: Under review
Developer: Curry Croquette
Publisher: AMATA K.K.
Official website (AMATA Games): https://amata.games/en/game/crescent-tower
Copyright: ©Curry Croquette Licensed to and published by AMATA Games
